page.overview:
Who is Poldor?

Poldor was a man of Númenor according to the early version of the legendarium in The Lost Road.

Poldor was a peer of Herendil who lived during the reign of Tar-Calion, possibly being one of the sons of the friends of Elendil, Herendil's father. Like many of the Númenóreans of that time, he had no love of the Elves and Elf-friends of the First Age. Herendil complained to his father that Poldor had called him Eärendel the previous day by way of scorn or mockery.

Poldor is a name in Quenya meaning "breaker up of the hard/tough" or "land-breaker", being derived from the root pol ("can, have physical power and ability; pound up, break up small, reduce to powder").

In earlier drafts of the Quenya language, the name Poldor was derived from pol in polda ("strong, burly").
